title: OwnFrame game updates
description: Validates data/updates.json: the items each Warframe update added, newest update first. Feeds the apps' "New" strip and the update stamp on published builds. Item lists are detected by scripts/detect-updates.mjs (diff of DE's Public Export against data/known-items.json); version, name and date are set by hand in the detection pull request. _-prefixed keys are file metadata, not data entries.

_source.description: Public Export file hashes (index_en.txt) the item lists were last checked against — lets the detector skip unchanged exports.

version.description: Main update version as DE numbers it, e.g. "44.0". Hotfix items belong to their main update's entry.

name.description: Display title, e.g. "Update 44: Iceblade of Narin" (from DE's update list or patch notes).

items.description: uniqueNames of the items this update added (exactly the Public Export uniqueName).
